mealAnalysis.guidance_message: This dessert contains strawberries and a sweetened cream or marshmallow component, which are moderate in carbohydrates and sugars, potentially impacting blood sugar levels in someone with diabetes. It is best to avoid or strictly limit this meal, opting for fresh strawberries with unsweetened Greek yogurt instead.
mealAnalysis.meal_title: Strawberries with Sweetened Cream and Crushed Nuts
mealAnalysis.meal_description: A dessert featuring fresh strawberries, a dollop of sweetened cream or marshmallow, and crushed pistachio nuts sprinkled on top.
